topic: Supply and demand, capital, basic economic principles

questions.q: 50. According to law of demand, if the price of goods increases then the demand of articles
questions.explain: The law of demand states an inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded.

questions.q: 51. According to law of supply, if the price of goods increases then the demand of articles
questions.explain: The law of supply states that, ceteris paribus, an increase in price results in an increase in quantity supplied as producers seek higher profits.

questions.q: 79. Expected output of any project should be........... to the investment of any investor.
questions.explain: In general investment theory, higher investments are expected to yield higher total outputs or returns.

questions.q: 125. In economic analysis a shift in the supply curve is said to take place due to
questions.explain: Shifts in supply (rather than movement along the curve) are caused by external factors like tech, costs, or competition.
